# Pakistani University Admissions (EasyPakUniAdmission)

> Admission dates, entry tests, fees and how-to-apply for Pakistani universities — in Urdu and English, made for F.Sc. students.

## What this site is

A single-page guide to undergraduate admission schedules for Pakistani universities. Each university shows: admission dates (upcoming + last cycle), the entry test, application fee, eligibility, a step-by-step "how to apply", and free test-prep resources.

## Universities

### FAST NUCES (National University of Computer & Emerging Sciences)
- Entry test: FAST NU Admission Test
- Application fee: Rs. 3,000
- Apply: https://admissions.nu.edu.pk

### LUMS (Lahore University of Management Sciences)
- Entry test: LCAT (or SAT / ACT)
- Application fee: PKR 11,500
- Apply: https://admissions.lums.edu.pk

### NUST (National University of Sciences and Technology)
- Entry test: NET (NUST Entry Test)
- Application fee: Rs. 5,000 per NET attempt
- Apply: https://ugadmissions.nust.edu.pk

### UET Lahore (University of Engineering and Technology)
- Entry test: ECAT (Engineering College Admission Test)
- Application fee: Rs. 3,000 (ECAT token)
- Apply: https://admission.uet.edu.pk

### GIKI (Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences and Technology)
- Entry test: GIKI Admission Test
- Application fee: Rs. 3,000
- Apply: https://admissions.giki.edu.pk

### PUCIT (Punjab University College of Information Technology)
- Entry test: PU Admission Test
- Application fee: Rs. 2,500
- Apply: https://admissiontest.pu.edu.pk

### PIEAS (Pakistan Institute of Engineering and Applied Sciences)
- Entry test: PIEAS Admission Test
- Application fee: Rs. 3,500
- Apply: https://admissions.pieas.edu.pk

## Notes

- Dates change every year. Always confirm on the official website before applying.
- The live site shows current/upcoming dates with countdowns: https://zeeshanalikhan15.github.io/EasyPakUniAdmission/
